title: Getting instant feedback: The dbt v2-powered dbt developer experience
description:
Inside dbt v2: how a rebuilt SQL engine makes linting up to 250x faster, with real-time feedback, dbt checks, Docs v2, and Compare Changes. Live demo from dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

dbt Labs engineering leader Alexander Bogdanowicz, who manages the org behind dbt v2, demos the new developer experience live. dbt v2 rewrites the Jinja templating engine in Rust, giving dbt semantic understanding of SQL grammar. Its linter runs 50 to 100 times faster than standard SQLFluff. The VS Code extension's Compare Changes runs a live data diff between a modified model and production, and in the demo it caught an accidental change.

In this session you'll learn:
• How semantic understanding of SQL powers real-time linting
• How dbt checks and Docs v2 work in practice
• How Compare Changes diffs data against production in VS Code

Speaker: Engineering leader, dbt v2, dbt Labs

Learn more about the dbt Fusion engine: https://www.getdbt.com/product/fusion
